command: kubectl -n invoicing-b201 get deployment taxcalc -o yaml
kubectl -n invoicing-b201 get deployment taxcalc -o wide && echo -e "\n--- Pod status ---" && kubectl -n invoicing-b201 get pods -l app=taxcalc -o wide

sleep 2 && kubectl -n invoicing-b201 get pods -l app=taxcalc -o wide && echo -e "\n--- Verify VERSION=2 ---" && kubectl -n invoicing-b201 get pods -l app=taxcalc -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}{"\t"}{.spec.containers[0].env[0].value}{"\n"}{end}'
